Selection Sort Finds the smallest element and swaps it with the first element. void selectionSort(int arr[], int n) { int min_idx, temp; for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) { min_idx = i; for (int | = 1 + 1; | < n; j++) { if (arr[j] < arr[min_idx]) min_idx = j; } temp = arr[min_idx]; //SWAP! arr[min_idx] = arr[i]; arr[i] = temp; }}
